# MNB Omni Caller

> MNB Omni Caller is an AI voice agent platform built by MNB Research (Abrobot Technologies Private Limited, Faridabad, Haryana, India). Businesses describe what they do in a sentence and get a human-sounding voice agent that answers and makes calls, qualifies leads, books appointments, sends reminders and follows up, 24/7, in 90+ languages with mid-call language switching. Indian phone numbers are included. Pricing is pay-as-you-go from Rs 12 per minute, with no card needed to start.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://omni.mnbresearch.com/): what the agent does, use cases, industries and pricing
- [Contact](https://omni.mnbresearch.com/contact.html)
- [Privacy](https://omni.mnbresearch.com/privacy.html) · [Terms](https://omni.mnbresearch.com/terms.html) · [Refunds](https://omni.mnbresearch.com/refund.html)

## Common uses
- Calling new leads within seconds of a form being filled
- Answering repeat questions from your brochure or website
- Appointment reminders and confirmations to cut no-shows
- Campaigns that work through old lead lists
- Call transcripts, sentiment and outcome scoring
